thread:
alex: Hey folks — first day! Running into a couple account setup hiccups, any pointers?

it-support: Welcome! Quick checklist: did you get the Okta invite email and the 1Password invite?

alex: I got the Okta invite but when I click the activation link it asks to verify my device then nothing happens. Push doesn't arrive to my phone.

it-support: Do you see a device enrollment step in the browser? Which phone are you using (iOS/Android)?

alex: iPhone 13, iOS 16. Tried both Safari and Chrome. No push notification.

mira: @alex try going into Okta > My Settings > Add a device -> choose "Send Push" then watch the Authenticator app. Sometimes the push gets blocked by Focus/Do Not Disturb. Also check push permissions in Settings -> Notifications.

alex: Checked DND, notifications allowed. Still nothing. I can get a "One-time passcode" option though.

it-support: If push flakey, use the OTP code path for now so you can finish onboarding. We'll sort push with Security.

sam: Hey @alex — for Google Workspace, did you accept the workspace invite? Sometimes IT sends that separately from Okta.

alex: I haven't seen a separate Google invite email. Only Okta + 1Password.

it-support: We generally provision GSuite after Okta activation, but there can be a short queue. Can you check spam? Also confirm the exact email you used to sign up.

alex: Using alex@redwood.ai (that's the address HR gave me). Nothing in spam.

itt-support: (typo) meant to say will check provisioning status. @anne (security) can you confirm provisioning for alex@redwood.ai?

anne (security): Looking now. Okta shows the user created but the provisioning sync to Google failed with "orgUnit not found" — weird.

it-support: @anne can you re-run the sync for that user? If org unit mapping failed we might need to set their team attribute in Okta first.

anne (security): I've kicked a manual sync. You should get a Google invite within ~10 minutes.

alex: Thanks. Back to 1Password — the invite link I got says "invitation expired" when I click it.

mira: I can re-send. @it-support can you re-invite to 1Password for alex@redwood.ai?

it-support: Done — new invite sent. Tip: open the invite link in a private window if you already have a personal 1Password account signed in.

alex: Got the new 1Password invite, setting up now. Okta OTP worked for me to finish activation. Google invite just arrived. Progress! :tada:

sam: If push doesn't show later, we can enroll a security key (YubiKey) or set up the Okta Verify app + QR scan as a fallback.

alex: Awesome — I'll try Okta Verify QR today. Thanks everyone for the quick help.

it-support: Marking thread resolved for now. If anything else pops up ping #new-hires or open a ticket with IT and mention this thread_ts:1728000459.

okta-bot: [system] Device enrollment detected for alex from Chrome on macOS.

alex: All good — devices enrolled, 1Password set, Google account working. Appreciate the help! :)
